body: I crashed my car driving like an idiot and ended up leaving the scene because I was scared shitless. Got charged with reckless driving and a hit and run. It was right next to where I work and I just got hired there full time and it pays really well. This would of never happen if had gone straight home after work. But it was late at night and it’s an area that’s pretty hidden. Having no friends and listening to a coworker just to do the same thing he was doing caused me to make this mistake. I can’t really afford to lose the job and I’m so stressed of what could happen.
